fact: On 2 November 2026 an IMF and AFRITAC technical assistance mission opened at the Ministry of Finance, with the Integrated Tax Revenue Management System (SIGREF) named as the instrument of tax administration reform, still to be implemented.
title: EL FMI Y AFRITAC INICIAN UNA MISIÓN DE ASISTENCIA TÉCNICA EN EL MINISTERIO DE HACIENDA PARA IMPULSAR LA MODERNIZACIÓN DE LA ADMINISTRACIÓN TRIBUTARIA
